title: TLS issue with Open5gs
body:
Hi I am trying to run open5gs in TLS mode using the apt method and it is giving me some errors.

I commented out this part of `/etc/open5gs/yaml` files of all network functions.

![image](https://github.com/open5gs/open5gs/assets/95766110/d50091c2-945d-4ffa-a3ed-be92814b1116)

and after restarting the services using the `systemctl restart` command it shows that all the network functions terminate[please check out the logs attached below]

[with_tls.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/15956557/with_tls.zip)

It is giving me this error: 

```
06/24 13:42:17.869: [app] INFO: Configuration: '/etc/open5gs/amf.yaml' (../lib/app/ogs-init.c:133)
06/24 13:42:17.869: [app] INFO: File Logging: '/var/log/open5gs/amf.log' (../lib/app/ogs-init.c:136)
06/24 13:42:17.875: [sock] ERROR: getaddrinfo(0:amf.localdomain:443:0x0) failed (2:No such file or directory) (../lib/core/ogs-sockaddr.c:116)
06/24 13:42:17.875: [sbi] FATAL: ogs_sbi_context_parse_server_config: Assertion `rv == OGS_OK' failed. (../lib/sbi/context.c:787)
06/24 13:42:17.875: [core] FATAL: backtrace() returned 7 addresses (../lib/core/ogs-abort.c:37)
/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libogssbi.so.2(ogs_sbi_context_parse_server_config+0x4a8) [0x7f8f1ca1d298]
/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libogssbi.so.2(ogs_sbi_context_parse_config+0x60a) [0x7f8f1ca2273a]
/usr/bin/open5gs-amfd(+0xa374) [0x562b7085c374]
/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libc.so.6(+0x29d90) [0x7f8f1c1f6d90]
/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libc.so.6(__libc_start_main+0x80) [0x7f8f1c1f6e40]
/usr/bin/open5gs-amfd(+0xace5) [0x562b7085cce5]
```

and the same is with other network functions as well.

```
two@two:/var/log/open5gs$ journalctl -u open5gs-amfd -b -f
Jun 24 13:43:54 two open5gs-amfd[949977]: 06/24 13:43:54.625: [sbi] FATAL: ogs_sbi_context_parse_server_config: Assertion `rv == OGS_OK' failed. (../lib/sbi/context.c:787)
Jun 24 13:43:54 two open5gs-amfd[949977]: 06/24 13:43:54.625: [core] FATAL: backtrace() returned 7 addresses (../lib/core/ogs-abort.c:37)
Jun 24 13:43:54 two open5gs-amfd[949977]: /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libogssbi.so.2(ogs_sbi_context_parse_server_config+0x4a8) [0x7ffb175cf298]

Jun 24 13:43:54 two open5gs-amfd[949977]: /usr/bin/open5gs-amfd(+0xa374) [0x56191a465374]
```
